scripts.test:pre-alpha: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @khlim/api build && node --test tests/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:pre-alpha:persistence: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @khlim/api build && node --test tests/integration/pre-alpha-persistence-integrity.test.mjs
scripts.test:pre-alpha:admin: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @khlim/api build && node --test tests/integration/pre-alpha-admin-http-integration.test.mjs
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm openapi:export && pnpm openapi:types
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/khlim-v1.json packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts
